newsitem.title: UK: UK's Channel 5 to bid for satellite space - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK's Channel 5 to bid for satellite space - paper.

text.p: Channel 5 Broadcasting, owned by Pearson and United News & Media, is planning to bid for newly available space on the Astra 1A satellite to reach an additional one million homes in the UK, the Independent newspaper said in its Wednesday edition.

The paper said Channel 5, which is due to be launched early in 1997, would pay up to 6.0 million stg a year to extend its coverage. It said the company would have to offer a competitive premium to win the satellite lease. The lease for the satellite transponder is being offered by Nethold, a Dutch-based broadcaster. Nethold is moving one of its channels to Intelsat, a competing satellite, the paper said.
